refnote: Image 1 is her face and the authority for who she is. Image 2 is the outfit. Image 3 shows how the outfit is worn on her. Image 4 shows her sweet smile.
id: The woman is exactly the same person as image 1: copy her face exactly — the same oval face, brows, large eyes, nose, lips and skin; do not change her features. Clean translucent makeup, straight natural brows, soft warm brown eye makeup, soft peach-coral lips. Same hair as image 1: dark hair loosely gathered high at the back of the head into a casual bun with loose pieces, centre part, two long strands of fringe hanging by the cheeks to the jaw. She wears exactly the outfit in image 2, worn the way image 3 shows it: a mustard-yellow silky blouse with a long soft pussy-bow tied at the collar and puffed long sleeves gathered into buttoned cuffs, tucked into the shorts; a single-strand pearl necklace; olive-green wool shorts with wide turned-up cuffs; cream-white ribbed over-the-knee socks, each with a wine-red ribbon bow at the top band; brown suede platform ankle boots with chunky block heels. No bag: the small plaid chain bag in image 2 is not part of the outfit, her shoulders carry nothing.
style: Plain flat seamless mid-grey studio background, one person only, soft even studio light. A real photograph of a real actress, real skin.
